title: Word-Level BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier
summary: The solution trains a CUDA word-level toxicity classifier on the provided training split and evaluates validation probabilities. Text is lowercased, regex-tokenized, truncated to 200 tokens, and mapped to a training-only vocabulary retaining tokens seen at least twice, capped at 120,000; other tokens become UNK. A two-layer bidirectional LSTM processes 192-dimensional embeddings with spatial embedding dropout. Masked mean and max pooling are concatenated, followed by two residual ReLU dense layers and a scalar logit head. It optimizes binary cross-entropy with logits against continuous target values using Adam, mixed-precision gradient scaling, gradient clipping, and a linearly decayed learning rate over two epochs. Length-bucketed shuffled batches reduce padding. Inference uses evaluation mode, length-bucketed batches, and sigmoid logits to produce validation probabilities.
